# Wake v0.2.0

Wake v0.2.0 completes the compiler-surface migration to Beagle's checked
projection contract and makes declaration structure explicit at the source
boundary.

## Breaking changes

- Structural declaration collections remain outer vectors, but every state
  value, transition, entity field, derived field, value-type definition, and
  entity extension entry is now one complete parenthesized form. Inner-vector
  and flattened spellings are rejected with source-local diagnostics.
- Checked compiler bundles now use schema version 4 and retain Beagle's
  public/internal models, imported-record metadata, effective types,
  provenance, and constraints rather than accepting the prior projection
  shape.

## Compiler and diagnostics

- Wake's compiler, demos, and wiki plugin now consume the same structural
  declarations across JavaScript and FRAM projection paths.
- Plugin configuration now flows through the checked declaration graph instead
  of a parallel JavaScript parser.
- Declaration failures preserve the exact macro, stray form, line, column, and
  span, while query results and derived expressions remain closed typed unions
  at the Beagle boundary.

## Runtime artifacts

- The release includes the source-bound Wake runtime archive and its receipt.
  The receipt binds the archive to this annotated tag, commit, and file
  digests.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tompassarelli/wake/compare/v0.1.3...v0.2.0
